development_data.reason: This sample was used for candidate comparison and lineage review and cannot be reused as fresh out-of-sample evidence.

hypothesis: Liquidity-neutral long momentum with defensive exposure control can deliver positive net benchmark-relative returns without breaching the small-capital drawdown and execution budgets.

primary_metric.name: net_cost_excess_cagr_vs_csi800_total_return
primary_metric.success_rule: positive with a block-bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound above zero after registered-trial correction

required_data: Human-approved source QA and retained usage terms
Point-in-time CSI 800 or delisting-aware broad A-share membership history
CSI 800 total-return benchmark with matching dates
A fresh holdout opened only after code, config, metrics, and stop rules are frozen
required_tests: Expanding or rolling train-select-test with purge and embargo
Benchmark alpha, beta, information ratio, tracking error, and block-bootstrap confidence interval
Deflated Sharpe Ratio and Probability of Backtest Overfitting using at least 18 registered trials
Initial capital stress at 100000, 200000, 500000, and 1000000 CNY
100-share lot, 5 CNY minimum commission, stamp tax, and 5/10/20 bps slippage execution
Defensive-regime attribution separating selection alpha from cash exposure
stop_conditions: Any source-QA, PIT-universe, dataset-identity, or benchmark provenance gate is BLOCK
The 100000 CNY portfolio cannot execute under lot and minimum-commission constraints
A rule or parameter is changed after the holdout is opened

promotion_boundary.unlock_rule: All required evidence and tests pass on a fresh, preregistered holdout; deterministic gates are rerun; human approval remains separate.
